facts.value: An Oriental Orthodox church of India. A group kept allegiance to the patriarchal claims of Antioch, and litigation in the courts followed.

citations.excerpt: A group continued to maintain allegiance to the patriarchal claims and therefore litigation in courts occurred.

facts.value_before_verify: An autocephalous Oriental Orthodox church in Kerala, India, headed by an Indian Catholicos. Some members remained loyal to the Patriarch of Antioch, and the two sides went to court.
